## Oak exploratory data analysis and cleaning

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

oak_data <- list.files(path = "Oak Project/Data",
                       pattern = "*6Clean.xlsx",
                       full.names = TRUE) |> 
  lapply(read_excel,
         na = "NA", sheet = "Input1",
         skip = 1) |> 
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
#importing and renaming October data
oct_data <- Survival_HeightOct2025Clean <- read_excel("Oak Project/Data/Survival_HeightOct2025Clean.xlsx", 
                                                      sheet = "Input1", skip = 1)
oct_data <- 
  oct_data |> 
  rename(page_num = "Page #",
         date = "MM/DD/YYYY",
         recorder = "Code",
         block = "#...4",
         tag_num = "#...5",
         oak_type = "NR, S, or A",
         treatment = "AC, OA, SA, NP, or DT",
         seedling_ht_cm = "(cm)...8",
         num_leaves = "#...9",
         base_seedling_circumference = "(cm)...10",
         base_seedling_diameter = "(mm)",
         is_saliva_apiana_alive = "Yes, No, or Missing?",
         notes = "as written on data sheet")

```

```{r}
#renaming non-oct data
oak_data <-
  oak_data |>
  rename(
    page_num = "Page #",
    date = "MM/DD/YYYY",
    recorder = "Name",
    block = "#...4",
    tag_num = "#...5",
    oak_type = "NR, S, or A",
    treatment = "AC, OA, NP, DT, or DL",
    oa_microclimate = "TH, TI, CN",
    seedling_ht_cm = "(cm)",
    num_leaves = "#...10",
    num_dead_leaves = "#...11",
    leaf_greenness = "%",
    num_germinated = "#...13",
    rcd = "(mm)",
    notes = "as written on data sheet"
  )
```

```{r}
oak_data_clean <- oak_data |> 
  separate(tag_num, into = c("tag_num", "acorn_num"), sep = "A") |> 
  mutate(tag_num = as.numeric(tag_num),
         acorn_num = as.numeric(acorn_num)) |> 
  mutate(leaf_greenness = as.numeric(leaf_greenness),
         dead = case_when(
           seedling_ht_cm == 0 ~ "dead",
           seedling_ht_cm > 0 ~ NA
         ))
```

```{r}
#Amy is still working on this!!!!!!!!
oak_data_clean |> 
  select(tag_num, acorn_num) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(tag_num)

acorn_id_table <- oak_data_clean |> 
  select(tag_num, block, treatment, oa_microclimate) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(tag_num) |> 
  mutate(acorn1 = 1, acorn2 = 2, acorn3 = 3) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(acorn1, acorn2, acorn3),
               names_to = "whatever", 
               values_to = "acorn_num") |> 
  select(-whatever)

oak_data_clean |>  full_join(acorn_id_table)
```
